dict.string: Self-Monitor records YOUR OWN audio only while you have it running, with a visible on-screen indicator and the iOS orange microphone dot. Recording never happens silently.
Self-Monitor tags your own recordings with your location so you can see your route on your dashboard.
Enable background location only if you want your worn device to keep logging your own position while the screen is off. iOS shows a status indicator the whole time.
Self-Monitor can capture photos from YOUR OWN device camera and stream them to your dashboard, only while a session is running with a visible on-screen indicator.
Self-Monitor uses motion sensors (accelerometer, gyroscope, pedometer) to stream device telemetry to your dashboard while a session is active.
